stories.title: Anthropic 称过去一年团队资历变高、开会时间变多
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，Anthropic 的员工构成和工作类型在过去一年发生明显变化：初级岗位占比下降，员工花在会议上的时间增加。这为观察 AI 公司内部人效和组织形态提供了一个少见的样本。
stories.analysis: AI 公司自身也在被 AI 重塑组织，初级岗位收缩可能成为这一代 AI 企业的共性特征。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.

stories.title: Meta 删除商业条款中可抓取新闻网站内容的措辞
stories.sourceTitle: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
stories.summary: 在遭到批评后，Meta 更新商业条款，删去暗示其可抓取网站（含新闻站点）内容训练 AI 的表述。Meta 同时强调，这不代表其网页抓取方式发生变化。
stories.analysis: 条款措辞的收窄更像是舆论压力下的合规修辞调整，实际抓取行为仍需外部审计验证。
stories.sourceExcerpt: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page: … Meta may use an

stories.title: Meta 回应抓取争议：改条款措辞，但称爬虫方式未变
stories.sourceTitle: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，Meta 在引发抓取与 AI 训练担忧后修改了相关条款表述，同时由发言人坚称这不反映其网页抓取方式的改变。争议焦点仍是平台内容被用于模型训练的边界。
stories.analysis: 当条款语言与实际行为脱钩时，出版商的谈判筹码只能来自监管而非合同。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

stories.title: Replit 将 OpenAI 设为默认模型提供方，Claude 仍可选
stories.sourceTitle: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
stories.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 澄清，OpenAI 已取代 Anthropic 成为平台默认模型供应商，Claude 仍对用户开放。编码类 AI 产品的底层模型供应链竞争正在加剧。
stories.analysis: 默认位是最贵的流量入口，模型厂商争夺的其实是开发者第一次点击。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

stories.title: 网站开始对 AI 智能体关上大门
stories.sourceTitle: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
stories.summary: OpenAI、Meta、Google 等力推能代替用户上网订餐、清邮箱、买东西的自主智能体，但 The Verge 指出越来越多网站正在设置访问限制。围绕智能体能否“代人行权”的博弈升温。
stories.analysis: 智能体时代的核心冲突不是模型能力，而是网站是否承认代理访问的合法性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Autonomous agents are the hottest thing in AI. OpenAI, Meta, Google, Instinct, and others promise their agents can scour the internet on your behalf, doing anything from booking a dinner reservation and cleaning out your inbox to buying new shoes. But what hap

stories.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X 实测一周：Arm 笔记本“超级芯片”表现如何
stories.sourceTitle: A week with RTX Spark: everything we’ve learned using Nvidia’s new laptops
stories.summary: The Verge 用一周时间测试了多台搭载 RTX Spark N1X 的笔记本，该芯片是面向笔记本和小型主机的 Arm 架构 SoC。测试聚焦实际性能、续航与本地 AI 负载表现。
stories.analysis: NVIDIA 把 Arm SoC 做进笔记本，实质是在为端侧推理寻找新的硬件落脚点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X processor is finally here, and we've been collectively testing a small fortune's worth of powerful laptops sporting this new "superchip." RTX Spark is designed to be a high-performing Arm-based SoC for laptops and small desktop computers

stories.title: Meta 新条款被指可免费抓取新闻网站内容训练 AI
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
stories.summary: 据 Nieman Lab 报道，Meta 将于 10 月 30 日生效的新条款似乎允许其抓取与平台商户“关联”的网站内容，包括在线出版商。该措辞引发新闻行业对内容被无偿用于 AI 训练的担忧。
stories.analysis: “关联商户”这一模糊定义，可能成为平台绕过授权谈判的通道。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta's new terms appear to give it permission to crawl and scrape websites "associated" with the businesses that use its platforms - including online publishers, according to a report from Nieman Lab. The new terms, which go into effect on October 30th, say Me

stories.title: 反科技情绪登上大银幕：2026 年批判硅谷的电影扎堆
stories.sourceTitle: The tech backlash is now in theaters
stories.summary: The Verge 指出，2026 年集中上映多部以批判视角审视科技创始人与硅谷影响的影片，包括 Aaron Sorkin 的《The Social Reckoning》。科技公司的公众形象正从叙事层面遭遇反弹。
stories.analysis: 当反科技成为卖座题材，说明公众情绪已经先于监管完成转向。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Though movies about disruptive tech founders are nothing new, 2026 has been unusually stacked with features that take a much more critical look at how Silicon Valley is reshaping our reality. Aaron Sorkin's The Social Reckoning frames Mark Zuckerberg as a robo

stories.title: 特朗普发布疑似 AI 修改照片宣传白宫修缮
stories.sourceTitle: Trump posts AI-edited photo to brag about White House restoration work
stories.summary: 特朗普在 Truth Social 发布一组白宫翻新照片，其中一张对比立柱旧貌与“修复后”状态的图片被指出存在多处 AI 修改痕迹。事件凸显政治传播中 AI 生成内容识别的现实难题。
stories.analysis: 政治人物使用未标注的 AI 修图，会把“是否真实”变成又一场立场之争。
stories.sourceExcerpt: President Donald Trump posted a series of photos on Truth Social showing off renovations to the White House - but one of them appears to be modified with AI. The picture, which compares an old White House column to a "restored" one, has several discrepancies a

stories.title: 巴西 Itaú 银行用 ia.i 与 IARA 平台向全量客户铺开生成式 AI
stories.sourceTitle: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
stories.summary: Itaú 通过对话式界面 ia.i 和治理平台 IARA，把“AI First”战略同时落到客户与员工场景。巴西银行业监管严格，这一案例对受监管行业的 AI 落地具有参考价值。
stories.analysis: 在强监管行业，治理平台往往比模型本身更决定项目能否规模化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

stories.title: Benefit Street Partners 用 Codex 加速贷款估值与信贷协议分析
stories.sourceTitle: Benefit Street Partners answers questions faster with Codex
stories.summary: 工程师 Anant Kumar 借助 Codex 做代码审查，并构建用于比较贷款估值、分析信贷协议的工具，从而更快响应后续问题。这是 Codex 在金融信贷场景的一个具体用法。
stories.analysis: Codex 的价值正在从写代码转向让业务人员更快拿到可核查的答案。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anant Kumar builds tools to compare loan valuations and analyze credit agreements, using Codex for code review and faster follow-ups.

stories.title: OpenAI 上线葡萄牙语版 AI for Educators，主打 Study Mode 提问式学习
stories.sourceTitle: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
stories.summary: 教师节之际，OpenAI 推出面向巴西葡萄牙语用户的教育者资源，展示 Study Mode 如何以逐步提问的方式支持学生主动学习。这是 ChatGPT 教育场景的本地化推进。
stories.analysis: 教育是 AI 最敏感也最高频的场景，本地化程度决定学校是否愿意放行。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Celebrate Teachers’ Day with AI for Educators in Brazilian Portuguese and see how Study Mode can help teachers support active, step-by-step learning.

stories.title: Sullivan & Cromwell 与 OpenAI 合作推出合同审阅工具 Agreement Analyzer
stories.sourceTitle: Sullivan & Cromwell brings legal expertise into agreement review
stories.summary: 律所 Sullivan & Cromwell 与 OpenAI 共同开发 Agreement Analyzer，用于识别合同草案中的问题。顶级律所开始把自身法律经验产品化，切入合同审阅环节。
stories.analysis: 律所自建 AI 工具，本质是把按小时计费的经验转成可复用的软件资产。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In collaboration with OpenAI, Sullivan & Cromwell developed Agreement Analyzer, an AI tool for identifying issues in a draft agreement.

stories.title: SentinelOne 用 OpenAI Daybreak 把恶意软件分析从数周缩到数小时
stories.sourceTitle: SentinelOne cuts malware analysis from weeks to hours
stories.summary: 借助 OpenAI Daybreak，SentinelOne 将原本耗时数周的恶意软件分析压缩到数小时，腾出产能调查更多威胁。安全运营的效率瓶颈正在被 AI 重新划分。
stories.analysis: 安全团队缺的从来不是告警，而是能把告警看完的人力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With OpenAI Daybreak, SentinelOne cuts weeks of malware analysis to hours, creating capacity to investigate more threats.

stories.title: Higgsfield 用 GPT-6 Astra 把 AI 视频从 1 分钟拉到 10 分钟以上
stories.sourceTitle: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
stories.summary: Higgsfield 结合 GPT-6 Astra、GPT-Image-2.5 和 GPT-Live，为创作者提供更长时长视频、更精细画面，并探索语音驱动的影片制作流程。AI 视频的时长限制正被逐步突破。
stories.analysis: 时长从 1 分钟到 10 分钟是质变，叙事结构和剪辑逻辑都会被重写。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Higgsfield brings creators longer videos with GPT-6 Astra, precise visuals with GPT-Image-2.5, and a path to voice filmmaking with GPT-Live.

stories.title: Sophos 用 OpenAI Daybreak 把威胁调查时间缩短 96%
stories.sourceTitle: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
stories.summary: Sophos 借助 OpenAI Daybreak 将网络威胁调查时间削减 96%，并自动化 52% 的 MDR 案件处理，同时保留人工监督。这是托管安全服务被 AI 改造的一个量化案例。
stories.analysis: 96% 的调查提速意味着 MDR 的商业模式会从人力密集转向模型与流程驱动。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.

stories.title: Pollo AI 用 GPT-5.6 与 GPT-6 Astra 把创意做成广告片
stories.sourceTitle: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
stories.summary: Pollo AI 基于 GPT-5.6、GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-Image-2.5，帮助创作者把想法转化为细节丰富的图像和电影感视频广告。营销素材生产链条正被模型组合重构。
stories.analysis: 广告行业会先被改变的不是创意本身，而是创意到成片的中间环节。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

stories.title: LegalOn 把 Codex 每日成本砍掉 65%，开发速度不降
stories.sourceTitle: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
stories.summary: LegalOn 通过按任务匹配合适模型（Astra、Sol、Luna）并进行预算管理，将 Codex 预估日均成本降低约 65%，同时保持开发节奏。这为团队控制 AI 编码成本提供了可复用做法。
stories.analysis: 模型分级调度会成为工程团队控制 AI 支出的标准动作。
stories.sourceExcerpt: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.

stories.title: OpenAI 阻断两起用假记者、假智库包装的 AI 影响行动
stories.sourceTitle: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
stories.summary: OpenAI 披露已阻断两起借助 AI 运营的影响行动，它们伪装成记者和智库，传播地缘政治叙事。这显示生成式 AI 正被用于低成本搭建“虚假媒体身份”。
stories.analysis: 影响行动的成本已降到只需几个账号和一套模型，平台治理窗口越来越短。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging.

stories.title: ChatGPT for Teens 上线 College Planner，并组建青少年 AI 委员会
stories.sourceTitle: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 青少年版加入大学申请规划工具 College Planner，同时推出闪卡、测验功能，并成立青少年 AI 顾问委员会参与产品讨论。青少年市场成为 ChatGPT 的专门产品线。
stories.analysis: 面向未成年人做产品，功能设计之外更考验 OpenAI 的安全与家长沟通能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

stories.title: OpenAI 公布内部前沿模型在数学开放问题上的新结果
stories.sourceTitle: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
stories.summary: OpenAI 发布内部前沿模型在若干数学开放问题上取得的新结果，并在 GitHub 公开 Lean 形式化证明与研究细节。可验证的形式化证明让 AI 的数学产出更容易被学界检验。
stories.analysis: 选择 Lean 形式化公开，是让数学界能验证而非只靠信任的关键一步。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

stories.title: OpenAI 与 Ironclad 在合同流程上训练和评测 computer use 智能体
stories.sourceTitle: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
stories.summary: OpenAI 与 Ironclad 合作，在复杂合同工作流中训练并评估能操作电脑的 AI 智能体。目标是把 computer use 能力推进到专业工作场景。
stories.analysis: 合同流程规则多、可验证性强，是检验智能体可靠性的合适试炼场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

stories.title: Atlassian 与 OpenAI 扩大合作，把企业知识接入前沿模型
stories.sourceTitle: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
stories.summary: Atlassian 与 OpenAI 扩大合作，将前沿模型与企业知识库连接，帮助团队完成规划、构建和交付工作。这是模型厂商争夺企业知识入口的又一动作。
stories.analysis: 谁掌握企业知识图谱，谁就掌握智能体在企业里的实际入口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

stories.title: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 上线新视觉广告格式，并扩充效果测量工具
stories.sourceTitle: Building advertising for the way people use AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 引入新的视觉广告形式，同时扩展测量工具、归因合作与品牌适配能力。ChatGPT 的广告商业化正在从试验走向体系化。
stories.analysis: 广告位进入对话界面后，如何不损伤答案可信度将是最难的产品题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

stories.title: Chatham 用 Codex 与 GPT-5.6 把交易校验从 30 分钟压到 4 分钟以内
stories.sourceTitle: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
stories.summary: Chatham Financial 使用 Codex 和 GPT-5.6 构建工具并重设工作流，将交易校验时间从 30 分钟缩短到 4 分钟以内。资本市场业务流程正被 AI 重新计时。
stories.analysis: 金融中后台的效率提升往往不显眼，但复利效应最强。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.

stories.title: 网易叭哥说拿出 10 万元征集真实需求，不卡专业学历
stories.sourceTitle: 说真话就能拿10万？网易叭哥说重金求“真需求”，不卡专业学历
stories.summary: 网易首个 AI 原生语音 Agent「网易叭哥说」上线“用户荣誉联创计划”，投入 10 万元征集产品建议，且不设专业与学历门槛。这是国内 AI 产品用共创方式收集需求的一次尝试。
stories.analysis: 用现金换真实吐槽，比在内部做用户调研更便宜也更接近真问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 网易首个AI原生语音Agent「网易叭哥说」上线 “用户荣誉联创计划”，投入 10 万元征集产品建议

stories.title: Akka 在 65 个开源项目中测试基于规格的 AI 交付
stories.sourceTitle: Akka 在 65 个开源项目中测试基于规格的 AI 交付
stories.summary: Akka 用 65 个开源项目检验“先写规格、再由 AI 实现”的交付方式，考察其可行性与质量控制效果。这为规格式开发在工程团队中的落地提供了样本。
stories.analysis: 规格先行能否奏效，取决于规格本身写得是否足够可执行。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard：面向 token 流的实时安全护栏模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen3Guard 是 Qwen 系列首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 基座针对安全分类微调，可在 token 流上实时判断内容风险。它把内容审核从整段生成后的后置检查前移到生成过程中。
stories.analysis: 护栏模型下沉到 token 级，意味着安全能力开始作为独立组件对外输出。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tech Report GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope DISCORD Introduction We are excited to introduce Qwen3Guard, the first safety guardrail model in the Qwen family. Built upon the powerful Qwen3 foundation models and fine-tuned specifically for safety classificatoin,
